projects.name: Roastery Ops
projects.description:
Everything that runs **Bean & Brew Roastery**: orders from the web shop, café and wholesale, roasting and stock, a morning sales report and low-stock alerts.

The data lives in a SQLite store at `~/Tipeline/output/roastery/roastery.db`; open **Roastery Manager** once to create it with sample data.
projects.instructions: This project runs a small coffee roastery. Money is in USD and weights in kg. Orders go New → Roasting → Shipped (or Cancelled). Use the Roastery workflows to read or change data; never edit the SQLite file directly. When someone asks what to roast next, run Roastery: Low Stock Check.

tasks.name: Roastery: Setup
tasks.description:
Sets up the roastery store, a SQLite database at `~/Tipeline/output/roastery/roastery.db`: the beans, roasts, orders and alerts tables, then (only the first time) eight coffees and about six weeks of sample orders.

Safe to run again: it never changes data once the tables have rows. The Roastery Manager app runs it when the Dashboard opens.

**Outputs**

- `seeded` — true when this run added the sample data
tasks.author: Jose Daniel Estrada

tasks.name: Roastery: Dashboard
tasks.description:
Reads the roastery store for the Roastery Manager's Dashboard: the headline numbers, sales by day, sales by channel, the best-selling coffees and the coffees running low.

A coffee is low when its stock is under the `roasteryLowStockKg` global.

**Outputs**

- `summary` — `{ revenue30, revenuePrev30, revenueTrend, ordersToday, openOrders, lowStock, kgSold30 }`
- `byDay` — the last 21 days: `[{ day, revenue, orders }]`
- `byChannel` — `[{ channel, revenue }]`, last 30 days
- `topBeans` — the 6 best sellers by kg, last 30 days: `[{ name, kg, revenue }]`
- `lowStock` — `[{ id, name, origin, stock_kg }]`
tasks.author: Jose Daniel Estrada

tasks.name: Roastery: List Inventory
tasks.description:
Lists the coffees in the roastery store with their stock, the last roast and a stock status, plus the recent roasts.

A coffee is **Low** under the `roasteryLowStockKg` global and **Out** at zero.

**Outputs**

- `beans` — `[{ id, name, origin, process, roast, price_per_kg, stock_kg, status, lastRoast, lat, lng }]`
- `beanOptions` — `[{ label, value }]` for a select
- `roasts` — the 15 latest roasts: `[{ id, bean, kg, roaster, notes, roasted_at }]`
tasks.author: Jose Daniel Estrada

tasks.name: Roastery: Record Roast
tasks.description:
Logs a roast batch and adds the roasted coffee to its stock.

**Inputs**

- `beanId` — the coffee roasted
- `kg` — roasted weight, more than 0 and at most 60
- `roaster` — who roasted it
- `notes` — optional tasting or profile notes

**Outputs**

- `bean` — the coffee after the roast: `{ id, name, stock_kg }`
tasks.author: Jose Daniel Estrada

tasks.name: Roastery: List Orders
tasks.description:
Lists the orders in the roastery store, newest first.

**Inputs**

- `status` — `all`, `open` (new or roasting), `new`, `roasting`, `shipped` or `cancelled`
- `days` — only orders from the last this many days; 0 for all

**Outputs**

- `orders` — `[{ id, customer, channel, bean, kg, total, status, created_at }]`
- `counts` — orders per status: `{ new, roasting, shipped, cancelled }`
tasks.author: Jose Daniel Estrada

tasks.name: Roastery: Add Order
tasks.description:
Takes an order: checks there is enough roasted coffee, saves the order as **New** and takes the coffee out of stock. The price comes from the coffee's price per kg.

**Inputs**

- `customer` — who ordered
- `channel` — `web`, `cafe` or `wholesale`
- `beanId` — the coffee
- `kg` — how much, more than 0

**Outputs**

- `order` — `{ id, customer, bean, kg, total }`
tasks.author: Jose Daniel Estrada

tasks.name: Roastery: Set Order Status
tasks.description:
Moves orders to a new status. Cancelling an order that hasn't shipped puts its coffee back in stock.

**Inputs**

- `ids` — order ids, or rows with an id (a table's selectedRows)
- `status` — `new`, `roasting`, `shipped` or `cancelled`

**Outputs**

- `count` — how many orders changed
tasks.author: Jose Daniel Estrada

tasks.name: Roastery: Notify Team
tasks.description:
Helper used by the other roastery workflows: saves an alert in the store (the Roastery Manager's Alerts page shows them) and, when the `roasteryAlertWebhook` secret global has a URL, posts it there too as `{ "text": … }` (Slack and most chat tools take that).

**Inputs**

- `message` — what to tell the team
- `level` — `info`, `warning` or `error`
- `source` — the workflow sending it
tasks.author: Jose Daniel Estrada

tasks.name: Roastery: Low Stock Check
tasks.description:
Looks for coffees under the `roasteryLowStockKg` global and tells the team (through Roastery: Notify Team) which ones to roast next. Runs every hour on a schedule.

Saves what it found in the `roasteryLastStockCheck` global, so other workflows and the assistant can see it without querying the store.

**Outputs**

- `low` — `[{ name, stock_kg }]`
- `summary` — one line, e.g. "2 coffees running low: Kirinyaga AA (4 kg), …"
tasks.author: Jose Daniel Estrada

tasks.name: Roastery: Daily Sales Report
tasks.description:
Writes yesterday's sales report as a Markdown file in `~/Tipeline/output/roastery/reports/` (`sales-YYYY-MM-DD.md`) and tells the team it's ready. Runs every morning at 8:00 on a schedule.

**Inputs**

- `daysAgo` — which day to report on: 1 is yesterday (the default), 0 is today so far

**Outputs**

- `report` — `{ day, orders, revenue, kg, topBean, byChannel }`
- `path` — the report file
tasks.author: Jose Daniel Estrada

tasks.name: Roastery: Simulate Orders
tasks.description:
Demo helper: places one made-up order through Roastery: Add Order, for a coffee that has enough stock, so the dashboards keep moving. Its schedule (every 20 minutes) is off — switch it on in Schedules to watch the numbers change.

**Outputs**

- `order` — the order placed
tasks.author: Jose Daniel Estrada

tasks.name: Data: Roastery Alerts
tasks.description:
The alerts the roastery workflows sent through Roastery: Notify Team, newest first, and the result of the last low-stock check (the `roasteryLastStockCheck` global).

**Inputs**

- `level` — `all`, `info`, `warning` or `error`

**Outputs**

- `alerts` — `[{ id, level, message, source, created_at }]`, at most 100
- `lastCheck` — `{ at, count, beans, summary }`, empty before the first check
tasks.author: Jose Daniel Estrada
